lines.text: He's salty because I won the card game.

data.define: Used when someone is upset or bitter, often after losing.

example.text: He's salty because I won the card game.

misuse.text: Don't call your teacher 'salty' for giving homework.

data.l1_ex: Ele está "salty" porque eu ganhei o jogo de cartas.

native.tip: “salty” = azedo; irritado; amargurado. Exemplo: “He's salty because I won the card game.”
